visual.description: Same race chart, focus shifts to the bottom 4 products. Eggs and coffee dim to 30% opacity. The 4 remaining lines (chips, milk, peanut butter, ice cream) are highlighted — all clearly below the 1.0 baseline and trending downward. Each line gets a subtle trailing glow in green (#5BBF8C at 10% opacity) as it sinks deeper into the green zone. Product names label each line at their 2019 position. The green zone below 1.0 has a faint pulse.

notes: The 'quiet' visual. The downward drift should feel gentle and persistent — not dramatic. Use the slow strokeDashoffset reveal. Each product name should fade in near its line as the voice mentions it (10-frame stagger between products). The green zone glow reinforces 'this is good news'. Peanut butter is the lowest — label it prominently. This scene creates the false sense of security that Act 3 will shatter.
